name: PD · Job Runner
description: Runs a PD stage script detached under timeout in a /opt/loot/patchdiff job dir, polls until done, returns result.json. rc 124 = timed out (partial), other non-zero throws.

parameters.command:
=PD_SH=$(cat <<'PD_SH_EOF'
H='{{ $json.remote_host }}'
K='/dev/shm/pd-ssh/{{ $json.run_id }}'
read -r -d '' JOB <<'PD_JOB' || true
D='{{ $json.job_dir }}'
case "$D" in /opt/loot/patchdiff/*/*/*) ;; *) echo 'bad job dir' >&2; exit 1;; esac
umask 027
mkdir -p "$D" && cd "$D" || exit 1
rm -f .done result.json
printf '%s' '{{ $json.script_b64 }}' | base64 -d > job.sh
setsid nohup bash -c 'timeout {{ $json.max_minutes }}m bash job.sh > job.log 2>&1; echo $? > .done' > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo '{"launched":true}'
PD_JOB
if [ -n "$H" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$JOB" | ssh -i "$K/id" -o UserKnownHostsFile="$K/known_hosts" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 root@"$H" 'runuser -u n8n -- bash -s'
else
  printf '%s\n' "$JOB" | bash -s
fi
PD_SH_EOF
)
exec bash -c "$PD_SH"

=PD_SH=$(cat <<'PD_SH_EOF'
H='{{ $('Validate Job').first().json.remote_host }}'
K='/dev/shm/pd-ssh/{{ $('Validate Job').first().json.run_id }}'
read -r -d '' JOB <<'PD_JOB' || true
cd '{{ $('Validate Job').first().json.job_dir }}' || exit 1
for i in $(seq 1 22); do [ -f .done ] && break; sleep 5; done
if [ ! -f .done ]; then echo '{"done":false}'; exit 0; fi
rc=$(tr -dc 0-9 < .done); [ -n "$rc" ] || rc=1
if jq -e . result.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then res=$(jq -c . result.json); else res=null; fi
jq -nc --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson r "$res" --arg tail "$(tail -c 1500 job.log 2>/dev/null)" '{done: true, rc: $rc, result: $r, log_tail: $tail}'
PD_JOB
if [ -z "$H" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$JOB" | bash -s; exit $?; fi
# Polls are idempotent, so ride out short SSH drops on long remote stages.
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  out=$(printf '%s\n' "$JOB" | ssh -i "$K/id" -o UserKnownHostsFile="$K/known_hosts" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4 root@"$H" 'runuser -u n8n -- bash -s') && { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0; }
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -ne 255 ] && exit "$rc"
  sleep 15
done
echo "ssh to $H failed 5 times" >&2
exit 255
PD_SH_EOF
)
exec bash -c "$PD_SH"
